dashboard.subtitle: Submit attendance and manage your availability.

pairings.title: My pairings
pairings.help: Pick the default time slot for each pairing (you still enter actual session times when submitting attendance).

availability.title: My availability
availability.help: Mark the time slots you can teach. These help coordinators schedule you.

attendance.title: Submit attendance
attendance.help: Record a session for one of your pairings. Service hours are computed automatically.

schedule.title: Room schedule
schedule.help: Your pairings are highlighted. Blocked cells are unavailable rooms.
